node.title: DBD:Oracle compatible with Oracle 12
node.author: Baldrik
node.doctext: I need to upgrade DBI and DBD:Oracle in Windows to something that works with Oracle 12.2. We're running ActivePerl 5.16.3 on a Win 2008 server and interfacing with Oracle 12.2, but using an 11g Oracle client because that's all our DBI and DBD:Oracle can handle (it was bundled into the msi ActivePerl install). The problem is that we have to upgrade to Win 2012 and Oracle 11g is not compatible - only 12.2 is. I need to to know if it is possible to install more recent versions of DBI and DBD:Oracle using old Perl 5.16.3 and what versions are compatible with Oracle 12.2
